title: Retcon
description: Retcon is a mod for minecraft that adds a few new weapon types
body:
Retcon is a mod for minecraft that adds a few new weapon types

The mod currently adds 2 weapons

the sickles have 1.7 attack speed, with 2 less attack damage of swords of that tier

the cleavers have 1.2 attack speed, with 1 extra damage compared to swords of that tier
